title: Automated carrier onboarding with FMCSA authority verification
body:
As an operations coordinator, I want new carriers' MC/DOT numbers checked automatically against the FMCSA database so we stop onboarding carriers with inactive authority or lapsed insurance.

**Acceptance criteria**

* Carrier signup form validates MC/DOT number against the FMCSA API
* Carriers with inactive authority or out-of-service orders are blocked with a clear message
* Insurance certificate expiry date is captured and a reminder is scheduled 30 days before expiry
* Ops dashboard shows the verification status of every carrier

**Context:** We onboarded a carrier with revoked authority last month, which created a compliance risk. Joe Smith (Head of Carrier Relations) is the business owner for this story and will sign off on the UX.
author: Abraham AIProject
